queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'NordVPN' AND publisher = 'Nord Security';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'NordVPN' AND publisher = 'Nord Security' AND version_compare(version, '8.16.1.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'nordvpn.exe');
